title: Setting shortcut property of plugin's bottom panel button do not work
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.dev6.official.dec5a373d

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev6 - macOS Sequoia (15.6.1) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) - Apple M1 Pro (10 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

If you set the the `shortcut` property of the button returned by `add_control_to_bottom_panel`, the shortcut does not work.  You can only set the shortcut for the button when calling `add_control_to_bottom_panel`.  Setting the shortcut directly has worked since 4.5.0 (possibly 3.x but I didn't check).

You can use `remove_control_from_bottom_panel` and then `add_control_to_bottom_panel` to update the shortcut, or restart the editor to make a new shortcut take effect.

If this is the intended behavior going forward then something should probably be added to the docs outlining the steps to change the shortcut while the editor is running.

### Steps to reproduce

Here's the relevant code for the attached MRP.  When run, you can use alt+1 to show/hide the blue control, but alt+2 does not do anything, but it should show/hide the red control.  Pressing the "nope" button does show/hide the red control.

`res://addons/demo/plugin.gd`
``` gdscript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin

var _working_button = null
var _broken_button = null

var _control1 = ColorRect.new()
var _control2 = ColorRect.new()

func _init():
	_control1.color = Color.BLUE
	_control1.custom_minimum_size.y = 100
	_control2.color = Color.RED
	_control2.custom_minimum_size.y = 100


func _make_alt_shortcut(which_key):
	var sc = Shortcut.new()
	var e = InputEventKey.new()
	e.keycode = which_key
	e.alt_pressed = true
	sc.events = [e]
	return sc


func _enter_tree() -> void:
	_working_button = add_control_to_bottom_panel(_control1, 'works', _make_alt_shortcut(KEY_1))

	_broken_button = add_control_to_bottom_panel(_control2, 'nope')
	_broken_button.shortcut = _make_alt_shortcut(KEY_2)


func _exit_tree():
	remove_control_from_bottom_panel(_control1)
	remove_control_from_bottom_panel(_control2)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[plugin_button_4_6.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24062061/plugin_button_4_6.zip)
